items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: we got the message that they wanted us over with Paul Ash the following week.

ctx.x: Orpheum Theater -- no, the Oriental Theater in Chicago with Paul Ash who was The Blue Streak of Vaudeville, another blue streak, he was the King Leader of Bands at that time -- Paul Ash. And we got there for the rehearsal, when we come to the stage door, the stage door man could not believe that we had come there to work. So he calls upstairs to tell them we were downstairs at the door to come to work. When the man come down to see us, he said we got the wrong place -- got the wrong place, I got the contract in…

side of town to tell them about us and ask for a date for us, and got a date for us. Come back and says, you got the wrong theater, the theater is the west side theater, I think he said the Ordean Theater over on the west side. Okay. So they expect you there. That's okay. I go to the theater, rehearse, go on do the show, the same guy that produces the show that Paul Ash is in, he went to see the show, too. He went to catch the show. When he caught the show, he came back to the theater and we got the message that…

left side, you know. So when Buck was going to rehearse the music that's what they told him about the piano then. He comes upstairs -- I'm unpacking -- he comes upstairs to tell me about it and I says, "Don't cry about it, we're not on the stage, we're not doing nothin' yet. Don't cry about it, I'll go down with ya and we'll see what it is." So he takes me downstairs, "Show me the fella," his name is MacDermott. Okay, I'll take care of it. Soon as I got a chance and there was a lull in what he was doing, I went…
